glosses: stemmed glass, glass, goblet or its content

examples.en: Would you like a glass of wine?

examples.text: Sólo tomé dos copas de vino.
examples.en: I only had two glasses of wine.

examples.text: ¿Me podría servir una copa de vino blanco?
examples.en: Could I have a glass of white wine?

examples.text: Tom se tomó tres copas de vino.
examples.en: Tom drank three glasses of wine.

examples.text: Dejó caer la copa y se rompió.
examples.en: He dropped the cup and broke it.
